segments.say: TenderFlow: secure, bilingual e-tendering for government entities, built on IBM FileNet and IBM watsonx Orchestrate.

Procurement is where public trust is won or lost. Approvals on paper and e-mail are hard to trace, sealed bids depend on people, every entity works a little differently, and auditors need evidence they can rely on.

TenderFlow runs the full cycle in one platform, from the departmental request to the award and the records. Integrity is designed in, each entity configures its own process without code, and it is built on IBM.
Chapter one: from request to tender.

segments.title: Every role starts with what needs them
segments.sub: The director's dashboard: approvals waiting, how long they have waited, and what was published this month
segments.say: Each user starts on a dashboard for their role. The director sees what waits for a decision, and for how long.

segments.title: It starts with a departmental request
segments.sub: The general manager's scanned letter, the budget and the department, captured once and approved in a chain
segments.say: A department requests a smart-meter platform. The scanned letter is stored, and the request is approved first.

segments.title: The approved request becomes a tender
segments.sub: The entity's own fields and live process checks appear on the tender automatically
segments.say: The approved request becomes a tender, with the entity's own fields and live checks of its process rules.
Chapter two: configure without code.

segments.title: A guided wizard for new tender cycles
segments.sub: Pick a starting point, the envelopes, approvals and stages, then review it in plain words before saving a draft
segments.say: A guided wizard creates new tender cycles. Choose a starting point, the envelopes, the approvals and the stages, then review everything in plain words before saving a draft.

segments.title: Every stage and its rules on one map
segments.sub: Process Studio: the entity's own rules, attached to the stages of its tender cycle
segments.say: The Process Studio maps every stage of the cycle and the rules attached to it.

segments.title: Rules from ready-made recipes
segments.sub: Pick a recipe, fill in the blanks step by step, and read the rule as a sentence
segments.say: In the Process Studio, rules start from ready-made recipes. The administrator fills in the blanks step by step and reads the rule as a sentence: tenders above five hundred thousand dinars need the Undersecretary.

segments.title: Test before you publish
segments.sub: The simulator shows which rules fire and the approval chain that results. Every version is kept and audited
segments.say: The simulator shows which rules fire and the resulting approvals. Rules can add controls, never remove them.

segments.title: The process stops what is not ready
segments.sub: The budget line and minimum local content are missing, so submission is held back with the reason
segments.say: This draft cannot be submitted yet: the budget line and local content are missing.

segments.title: Approval chains adapt to risk
segments.sub: The director has approved. The Undersecretary level was added by the high-value rule
segments.say: The director approved; the high-value rule added the Undersecretary.
Chapter three: sealed bids to award.

segments.title: The entity's public tender board
segments.sub: Suppliers see the open tenders without signing in
segments.say: Suppliers see the entity's open tenders without signing in.

segments.title: Fully bilingual, Arabic and English
segments.sub: The supplier portal in Arabic, right to left
segments.say: Suppliers work in Arabic or English. Here is the supplier portal in Arabic.

segments.title: Bids stay sealed until the deadline
segments.sub: Each bid is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Until the opening, no one can read it in TenderFlow, administrators included
segments.say: Bids are encrypted on arrival; until the opening, not even an administrator can read them.

segments.title: Only the committee chair opens, only after the deadline
segments.sub: The opening is recorded with the attendees and a fingerprint of every bid
segments.say: Only the chair opens the bids, after the deadline, with attendees and fingerprints recorded.

segments.title: Evaluation and award with segregation of duties
segments.sub: Evaluators score, the chair recommends, and a different person approves the award
segments.say: Evaluators score each bid, the chair recommends the award, and a different person must approve it. The system enforces this separation.

segments.title: Awarded, with every step on the timeline
segments.sub: Who did what, when and why, from the first draft to the award
segments.say: The tender is awarded, and the timeline shows who did what, when and why.
Chapter four: IBM FileNet.

segments.title: Every document lives in IBM FileNet
segments.sub: Object ID, document class, folder, version and SHA-256 hash, read from the Content Engine
segments.say: Every document is stored in IBM FileNet. For any file, users can see the FileNet object, its class, folder, version and hash.

segments.title: IBM FileNet as the system of record
segments.sub: A folder for each entity and tender, with TenderFlow classes and properties
segments.say: FileNet is the system of record, with a folder per entity and tender.

segments.title: Search FileNet, within TenderFlow's access rules
segments.sub: Content Engine search, limited to the entity. Sealed bids stay hidden until they are opened
segments.say: Users search FileNet directly, always within TenderFlow's access rules. Sealed bids stay hidden until they are opened.
Chapter five: governance and insight.

segments.title: A tamper-evident audit trail
segments.sub: Every action is chained with HMAC and append-only. Integrity is verified with one click
segments.say: Every action is recorded in an append-only audit trail, chained so that any change is detectable. The auditor verifies it with one click.

segments.title: Evidence packs for auditors
segments.sub: One file with the documents, hashes, audit chain and decisions, verifiable offline
segments.say: For an audit, TenderFlow produces an evidence pack: the documents, their hashes, the audit chain and the decisions, in one file that can be verified offline.

segments.title: Insight for leadership
segments.sub: Cycle times, tender status, categories and supplier participation
segments.say: Leadership sees cycle times, tender status and supplier participation.

TenderFlow includes ten advisory agents for IBM watsonx Orchestrate, from request classification to the evaluation narrative. They are advisory only: a person always decides, and every run is audited. New in this release, the AI builder: an administrator describes a change in plain language, the agent proposes it, TenderFlow validates it, and only drafts are created.

Each government entity runs its own dedicated installation, with its own committees, users and suppliers. It runs on Red Hat OpenShift, with single sign-on, two-step verification and signed integrations, and the integrity controls are locked.
TenderFlow: integrity built in, flexibility without code, on IBM.
